name: Blox Fruits RNG
desc:
🏴‍☠️Ahoy, Robloxian pirate!🏴‍☠️  

🍎🍇Welcome to Blox Fruit's RNG🍍🍏

🦜Kick off the life of pirate on the high sea where instead of parrot, luck is your best friend! 🏴‍☠️
🔮Spin your way to victory! Discover all of the Devil fruits hidden across the Seven Seas and unravel its mischievous powers!⚡

🎰🎲 TAP the "Spin" button to get 58+ unique devil fruits and its Aura! 

😋😈 EAT the devil fruits to transform!

🧪💨 CRAFT Potions with your devil fruits!

⚗️🍹 USE Potions to increase your luck!

Tip: Don't craft potion from single fruit!🍓 Instead, collect many devil fruits as big batches before you craft to obtain higher tier potions! 🍍🍎🍓🍇

Note: Play on highest graphics settings for the best experience. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

☸ Good luck and Bon voyage! ⚓🧭
